# Joust Clone — Design Spec

**Date:** 2026-07-17
**Status:** Approved design, pending user spec review
**Target:** Desktop (Windows), Python 3.13 + pygame-ce
**One-liner:** Faithful clone of arcade Joust (Williams, 1982) with updated HD pixel-art visuals, all graphics and audio generated by GPT-authored code.

## Goals

- Full arcade feature set: flap physics, lance-height jousting, three buzzard tiers, eggs that hatch and escalate, lava troll, pterodactyl, platform erosion, wave types (normal / survival / egg / pterodactyl / team), 2-player simultaneous co-op with friendly fire.
- Updated visuals: HD pixel art (16-bit era look) — detailed ~32px sprites, rich palette, smooth animation. Not a pixel-perfect 1982 reproduction.
- All art and sound produced by deterministic generator scripts (GPT/Codex-authored code → PNG/WAV). No downloaded assets, no image APIs.
- Playable immediately via `python -m joust`; optional PyInstaller exe at the end.

## Non-Goals

- Arcade ROM accuracy (timings, RNG, exact wave tables). We approximate to *feel* faithful; all schedules live in `config.py` and are tunable.
- Online play, networking, mobile, level editor.
- Atari 2600 aesthetics or hardware constraints (explicitly rejected during brainstorming in favor of updated visuals).

## Architecture

```
G:\Joust\
  joust\
    __main__.py      python -m joust entry
    main.py          init, fixed-timestep loop (60 Hz update, render interpolation)
    config.py        ALL tuning constants: physics, speeds, scores, wave tables, erosion schedule
    assets.py        loads sprite sheets via sprites.json manifest; loads WAVs; auto-regen hook
    states.py        state machine: attract -> playing -> game-over -> high-score entry
    world.py         platform layout, erosion, lava strip, horizontal screen wrap
    combat.py        joust resolution: lance-height compare, tie bounce, mount/dismount rules
    waves.py         wave director: composition tables, spawn pads, wave-type logic, ptero timer
    hud.py           score, lives, wave banners, high-score table
    audio.py         SFX playback, channel management
    entities\
      player.py      rider + mount, flap physics, input binding, respawn invulnerability
      enemy.py       buzzard rider AI, three tiers
      egg.py         fall/bounce/rest, hatch timer, hatchling, remount escalation
      pterodactyl.py spawn logic, flight pattern, mouth-hitbox kill rule
      troll.py       lava hand: grab, drag, escape-by-flapping
  tools\
    gen_sprites.py   Pillow renderer -> assets\sprites\*.png + sprites.json (frame rects, anchors)
    gen_sfx.py       numpy synth -> assets\sfx\*.wav
  assets\            generated output only; gitignored except .gitkeep; rebuilt by tools
  tests\             pytest, headless (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy)
  docs\superpowers\specs\   this spec; plans in docs\superpowers\plans\
```

Module boundaries: entities never touch pygame display directly — they expose position/frame state; `main.py` renders. `combat.py` and `waves.py` are pure logic (no pygame surfaces) so tests run headless and fast. `config.py` is the single tuning surface.

## Gameplay Spec

### Physics (starting values — playtest-tune, all in config.py)

- Logical playfield 640×360. Gravity ~420 px/s². Flap impulse ~-160 px/s (each press; no hold-to-fly). Horizontal thrust ~300 px/s² while direction held, air drag low (~0.98/frame), max |vx| ~220 px/s.
- Horizontal screen wrap for all airborne/ground entities. No vertical wrap: ceiling clamps, lava kills (except troll grab intercepts first).
- Ground: mounts run, skid on direction reversal (brake sprite), take off by flapping.

### Jousting

- Collision between two mounted riders: compare lance Y (anchor offset per mount sprite, defined in sprites.json).
- Higher lance (smaller y) wins. |Δy| ≤ 4 px = tie → both bounce apart, no kill.
- Loser: mount flies off screen, rider ejects an egg (enemy) or dies (player loses life). Friendly fire between P1/P2 always on — winner scores 500 (original "gladiator" rule approximation: no team-wave bonus if players joust each other).
- Player vs unmounted hatchling/knight: touch collects (scores as egg-chain value).

### Enemies

| Tier | Name | Points | AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bounder (red) | 500 | Drifts, random flaps, no pursuit |
| 2 | Hunter (grey) | 750 | Seeks nearest player, matches altitude sloppily |
| 3 | Shadow Lord (blue) | 1500 | Fast, hovers high, dives to force high-lance losses |

Defeated enemy → egg (see below). Hatched egg that remounts comes back **one tier up** (caps at Shadow Lord). Buzzards without riders (post-joust) fly off screen and despawn.

### Eggs

- Fall with gravity, bounce with damping, rest on platforms; egg landing in lava is destroyed (no points).
- Collect chain within one wave: 250 / 500 / 750 / 1000, resets each wave.
- Uncollected egg hatches after ~8 s → hatchling stands (collectible ~4 s) → buzzard swoops in → remounts (tier+1) → hostile again.

### Lava Troll

- Active wave 2+. Any mounted entity flying within grab band (~24 px above lava) may be grabbed: hand sprite rises, latches, drags down at ~40 px/s.
- Escape: each flap press adds upward escape impulse; break free above the band. Dragged fully under = death (player) / destroyed, no egg (enemy).

### Pterodactyl

- Anti-camping timer: spawns ~20 s after wave start if enemies remain; respawns every ~15 s after leaving.
- Flies horizontal sine pattern toward player, mouth opens on approach. Invincible everywhere EXCEPT open mouth vs lance tip = kill, 1000 pts. Any other contact kills the player. Despawns when wave ends.
- Pterodactyl waves: 2–3 spawn immediately at wave start.

### World / Platforms

- Classic 8-platform arcade layout approximation: top-center, upper-left/right cliffs, mid-side ledges, large bottom platform flanking lava, two small floaters. Exact geometry defined once in `world.py` as data.
- Spawn pads on 4 platforms: entities materialize (shimmer-in ~1 s, invulnerable until they move or timer ends — applies to players and enemies).
- Erosion schedule (config): wave 4 burns bottom-center span, wave 6 burns mid-side ledges, wave 9 burns a floater. Erosion animates as lava-burn and is permanent for the run.

### Waves

- Composition table in config; approximation of arcade progression, explicitly NOT claimed ROM-exact:
  - W1: 3 Bounders (troll inactive, grace wave). W2: 4 Bounders. W3: 2 Bounders + 2 Hunters. W4+: mixed 4–6, Hunters dominant. W7+: Shadow Lords enter, 1–2 per wave.
  - Survival wave every 5th (W5, W10, …): banner + 3000 bonus per player who loses no life.
  - Egg wave at W8, then every 5th (W13, …): starts with 6 eggs pre-placed on platforms, no buzzards; race the hatch timers.
  - Pterodactyl wave at W11, then every ~7th: 2–3 pteros at start plus normal buzzards.
  - Team wave (2P only), first at W6 then every 5th: 3000 each if players don't joust each other that wave.
- Wave-type precedence when schedule slots collide on one wave number: survival > egg > pterodactyl > team; the losing type skips to its next scheduled slot.
- Wave ends when all buzzards + eggs + hatchlings cleared (pteros don't block wave end).
- Lives: 3 start, +1 per 20,000. Respawn on pad with shimmer invulnerability. Both players dead = game over.

## Graphics Pipeline (the GPT part)

- `tools/gen_sprites.py`: deterministic Pillow code that **draws** every sprite programmatically — shapes, palette ramps, shading, dither, outlines. No randomness without fixed seed. Output: `assets/sprites/<sheet>.png` + `assets/sprites/sprites.json` manifest `{sheet, frame name -> rect, anchor, lance_offset}`.
- Sprite inventory (frame counts are minimums): ostrich+knight P1 — stand, run×4, flap×3, brake; stork+knight P2 (palette variant); buzzard+rider ×3 tiers (tint ramps) — flap×3, glide; riderless buzzard flap×2; knight hatchling ×2; egg ×2 + crack; pterodactyl — fly×2, mouth-open; troll hand — rise, grab, drag; platform tile set incl. eroding/burn ×3; lava strip animated ×4; spawn shimmer ×3; bitmap font (0-9 A-Z + punctuation); title logo.
- HD pixel art style contract: ~32 px character height (mounts ~40×32), 3-tone-per-hue ramps + black outline, no anti-aliasing (crisp pixels), consistent light from upper-left.
- Render: nearest-neighbor integer scale (×2 default → 1280×720 window), F11 fullscreen (largest integer scale, letterboxed).
- Iteration loop: art critique happens on the *rendered PNG*; fixes are code edits + regenerate. Sheets are diffable artifacts.

## Audio Pipeline

- `tools/gen_sfx.py`: numpy synthesis → 22050 Hz 16-bit WAV: flap thwump, joust clang, egg plop, hatch pop, collect chime (pitch rises with chain), ptero screech, troll rumble, spawn shimmer, wave fanfare, death sting, bonus jingle, high-score loop (short).
- `audio.py`: pygame.mixer, 8 channels, per-sound cooldown to avoid flap-spam clipping.

## Controls

- P1: ←/→ move, Space flap. P2: A/D move, Left-Shift flap. P pause, Esc to menu, F11 fullscreen.
- Gamepads: auto-detect up to 2 (first pad → P1, second → P2); stick/dpad X move, button 0 flap. Keyboard always active alongside.
- Attract screen: 1/2 (or Start button) selects player count.

## Persistence & Error Handling

- High scores: top 10, 3-initials entry, `%APPDATA%\JoustClone\highscores.json`, atomic write (tmp-then-rename). Corrupt/missing → reset to defaults silently, game continues.
- Missing/stale generated assets at startup: `assets.py` invokes the tool scripts once automatically; if generation fails, exit with a clear one-line error (no partial boot).
- Second monitor/DPI: SDL handles; we only request integer-scaled window.

## Testing

- pytest, headless (`SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy`), no display needed: physics step determinism (fixed dt), joust resolution table (higher/lower/tie × mounted/unmounted), egg lifecycle timing, remount tier escalation, wave composition + sequencing, erosion schedule, troll grab/escape math, ptero mouth-hitbox rule, score/extra-life accrual, high-score round-trip + corrupt-file recovery.
- Generator tests: run tools, assert manifest completeness (every frame name the game references exists), sheet dimensions, determinism (two runs byte-identical).
- Manual smoke gate before "done": run game, verify each feature visually, screenshot record.

## Process (standing house rules)

- SDD: Claude specs, gates, verifies, commits. Codex implements every task including both generator scripts. Codex plan-roast of the written plan BEFORE execution. Blind cross-vendor Codex review of the final branch.
- Sandbox prep (Claude, outside sandbox, before dispatch): create `.venv` (Python 3.13), install pygame-ce + Pillow + numpy + pytest (sandbox has no network); verify RX grant on Python313 still present; git repo stays Claude-only (sandbox denies git metadata by design).
- Codex pytest recipe: pin TEMP/TMP into workspace + separate `--basetemp`, forward slashes, `pytest.exe` never `-m` (per codex-sandbox-constraints).

## Risks

- **Feel tuning**: flap physics is the game. Mitigation: all constants in config, early playable milestone, tune before content build-out.
- **GPT art quality variance**: procedural pixel art may need several critique rounds. Mitigation: style contract above, per-sheet review on rendered output, art tasks isolated from logic tasks.
- **Wave-table fidelity**: approximation may feel off to Joust veterans. Mitigation: labeled non-goal; table is config-editable.
